Edges ±0.012 mm overall (the margin's standard error with 0.011 mm, the method's largest error on the rasters drawn under vector outlines) and ±0.14 mm locally (half a pixel). Against the published values the area -0.11 %, Ix -1.09 %, Iy -0.58 %. The module cores are labelled M16 by the shop's description, the corner holes M6 by the drawing on p. 20.
